title: OEIS A354427 has no other terms below 10^11
description: The primes p ≤ 10^11 for which there are primes q, r with q | p+1, r | q²+q+1 and p | r²+r+1 (OEIS A354427, T. Yamada) are exactly 3, 13, 19, 631, 1794067711 and 10855016833. Hence a(5) = 1794067711, a(6) = 10855016833, and there is no a(7) below 10^11; the previous search bound was 2^24. The repository contains the reduction lemma that decides each pair (p, q) with one division instead of factoring q²+q+1, the search program, the complete search log in blocks of 10^9, and a verifier that runs with the Python standard library only.
